title: Common small injective generators for simplicial-category diagrams under universe enlargement
statement:
Fix a Grothendieck universe $\mathcal U$ and a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category $D$. A simplicial category has a set of objects, simplicial mapping sets, associative simplicial composition and identity vertices; its enriched functors may change the object set. Use the fixed $\mathcal U$-small Bergner generating sets $I,J$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting]. For any containing universe $\mathcal V$ (including $\mathcal U$), let $\mathcal C_{\mathcal V}=\operatorname{Fun}(D,\mathrm{sCat}_{\mathcal V})$, the ordinary category of functors and natural transformations. A map has the right lifting property against a family if every commutative square with a left side in that family has a diagonal filler. Write $K\text{-cof}_{\mathcal V}$ for the maps of $\mathrm{sCat}_{\mathcal V}$ with the left lifting property against all maps with the right lifting property against $K$, for $K=I,J$. Write $L_{K,\mathcal V}$ for the transformations in $\mathcal C_{\mathcal V}$ whose every component lies in $K\text{-cof}_{\mathcal V}$. A weakly saturated class contains isomorphisms and is closed under pushouts, transfinite compositions continuous at limit ordinals, and retracts in the category of arrows; a retract there is a pair of commutative squares whose composite is the identity square. Colimits are the universal cocones of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. All indexing sets and ordinal sequences in this closure are small in the indicated universe.

There exist two $\mathcal U$-small sets $S_I,S_J$ of arrows of $\mathcal C_{\mathcal U}$ such that, for $K=I,J$ and every such $\mathcal V$, the weakly saturated closure in $\mathcal C_{\mathcal V}$ of the images of $S_K$ is exactly $L_{K,\mathcal V}$. The same sets of arrows, with the same sources, targets and diagram structure maps, work for every containing universe; only the permitted sizes of coproducts and transfinite compositions in their closures change.

source.place: Lemma A.2.8.3 and Lemma A.3.3.3, in particular its proof at printed pp.878-884 (cardinal conditions (i)-(v), compatible slices A.3.3.15--17), specialized to ordinary D and the fixed Bergner I or J. The proof of Corollary A.3.6.18, printed p.905, shows that the regular bound can be kept under universe enlargement; the identical U-small sets here are obtained by taking U-small representatives of the bounded compact endpoint diagrams and transporting the compatible-slice construction. This is an explicit common-universe refinement, not a verbatim statement of Corollary A.3.6.18. Read online 2026-10-17; archival HTT WANTED. No Stacks tag states this model-theoretic generation result.
